body:
Handoff mode: execution is stopped at the user's request. Resume from [parent #5090's durable handoff guide](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/blob/8994a4b22c465da5d1231f2ce0c937d5441c3c8a/docs/evidence/r1-5090-handoff-20261008/README.md); all remaining acceptance gates stay open.

Cached native leaf writers can retain unreachable historical bytes because maintenance protects files that are still current. This change hands off the installed cached producer before public leaf pack/GC, keeps identity pins and held readers, and returns confirmed physical-removal receipts to existing accounting. Pending publication drains release the complete lock cut before retry; Close joins the borrowed inspection and callback owners.

Healthy leaf and hot value-log writers remain installed when a peer advances the future sequence reservation floor. Preservation requires physical identity, both real Managers and the installed pin registry to agree. The rollover observer covers every configured physical writer, reports unused leaf slots explicitly, and rejects missing writers or unrepresentable FileIDs.

Observed value-source reclamation now releases its completed cached write fence before leaf GC takes its own checked producer handoff. Holding that fence caused a recursive writeMu acquisition: both Linux and Mac CI timed out in TestRemainingTemplateV1MeasurementStorageReconstructsJSONBenchRows. The same deadlock reproduced locally before the correction. Value revalidation, reclaim and missing-retain cleanup remain fenced; early errors release once. Leaf deletion still requires its independent reachability, recoverable-root and held-reader checks.

Related to #5098 and parent #5090. This PR remains **draft and gate-blocked**. Unchanged-default natural rollover, an accepted common operation count N, complete held/current/reopen oracles, drained physical storage plateau and matched O/C/F public update performance remain outstanding. Finite caller residency and whole metadata-cap admission remain closed. No performance improvement is claimed from component controls.

Validation: the corrected runtime at 8844d706 passes all 15 selected top-level/36 named controls in both pinned Mac normal and race builds, including the public JSONBench regression and explicit success/error fence-release controls; zero skips, failures or missing tests. ROOT audited actual source, compiler, module, tool, test inventory and process joins. Independent source review accepts the correction. Earlier 15 top-level/50 named reconciliation/observer controls and the failed deadlock reproduction remain retained as source-bound predecessor evidence. The refreshed common protocol applies this correctness correction identically to O/C/F; compilation or component controls do not accept N or qualify rollover. Local artifacts await the explicitly scheduled server185 archive window.

Documentation describes the producer lock order, observed-value-to-leaf handoff, persistent value-log retention, physical identity checks, hot-writer behavior and observer completeness. Latest-head CI and final review remain required before readiness or merge.
